entries.body:
HISTORY [S1.1] Format was CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; rows ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.2, S4.2, S5.2] Scope: role 'admin' any project; viewer only records with owner==user['name'] any project (S5.2); others (non-viewer) records with project in user['projects'] OR owner==user['name'] (S4.2); others silently skipped.
CURRENT [S1.3, S5.1] Status: only 'active'; archived too only if role admin and params.get('include_archived') is True (S5.1); non-admin never archived.
HISTORY [S1.4] since compared created only.
CURRENT [S1.4, S3.2] params 'since' YYYY-MM-DD: only records whose updated (if present) else created >= since.
CURRENT [S1.5] Title stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
CURRENT [S1.0] API export_records(records,user,params)->str; record keys id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str keep exact),confidential,created,region,optional updated; don't modify input; ignore unknown params.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision: date filter introduced for monthly reconciliation runs.
HISTORY [S2.1] viewer used to raise PermissionError; replaced by S5.2.
CURRENT [S2.2, S4.1] confidential True never exported, except role admin and purpose 'audit' or 'regulator' (S4.1); other rules still apply.
CURRENT [S2.3, S5.3] params max_records int>=1: only first N (asc id) after all other rules; N>20 treated as 20 (S5.3).
CURRENT [S2.4] Obligation: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format includes top-level 'exported_by'=user['name'].
CURRENT [S2.5] Obligation: if confidential records exported for purpose other than 'audit', export includes top-level 'confidential_count' = number of confidential records in it.
CURRENT [S2.6] region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions'] (admins too).
CURRENT [S3.1, S1.1, S1.5, S2.4] Format: json.dumps object {'records':[{id int,title stripped,owner,amount str exact}] asc id, 'exported_by': user['name']}; no records -> empty list.
CURRENT [S2.5] confidential_count added when confidential exported and purpose!='audit' (implemented).
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: web UI shows owner display names; exports keep stored owner.
HISTORY [S4.3] Decision: move to JSON made for new reporting API.
NOTE: regulator purpose exports with confidential include confidential_count (purpose!='audit').
